scope: Distinct v19 runtime ON admission after verified native Fender enable; no hardware action

gravity_source.behavior: Requests TARGETf with AUTO initially clear, waits actual active (or externally-clocked >=4), then enables AUTO. No unchanged ACTUALf guarantee after AUTO.
Considers actualf active, or TARGETf and AUTO enabled regardless of actual.
Restored AUTO may immediately gate actual; checks targetf and reset/disable/PSreset/busy clear, omits actual from final policy mask only while original AUTO enabled.

matched_native_numeric_sites.behavior: Extracts ACTUAL from bits7:4 of PS word.
Extracts then replaces minimum state bits19:16. Does not bind minimum to PS_AUTO27:24.
Existing AUTO active branch requires targetf, clears AUTO in preserved PS image, writes, then polls ACTUALf. A live TARGETf/AUTO-enabled word is not itself required to retain actualf.

experimental_policy.before_fender_complete: Exact existing (word & 0x80001cff) == 0xff; domain_ON and valid BEFORE still required
experimental_policy.after_fender_complete: TARGETf; RESET31/DEV_DISABLE10/BUSY11/PS_RESET12 clear; actualf allowed, gated actual0/4 requires AUTO1; no other actual nibble admitted
experimental_policy.PS_AUTO_and_MIN: Decoded in receipt; no speculative relationship or policy write
experimental_policy.physical_OFF: Original domain_on0 and (word & 0x90001cff)==0 unchanged; CPU stop/native idle and PM accounting unchanged

qualification.source_hook_binding: Root-owned new source preparer; this report alone does not establish owner hook ordering

limitations: AUTO target-active is an admission policy, not an assertion that GPU clocks are currently ungated.
State0 acceptance follows explicit Gravity AUTO policy and named enum; not directly observed in v18 after Fender enable.
The Fender transfer remains an experimental ordering hypothesis for FW-mediated submission; native addKicks is not replayed.
No GPU execution, retirement, physical OFF, reset scope or management rejoin success is established by CPU helper tests.
